scope: Mean and variance of a transported claim composed from its source-sampling, target-sampling and transport-functional pieces under a supplied covariance (non-unit coefficients, negative cross terms) and under eight aligned rows of one joint law, plus the refusal of independence and unknown dependence.
independence_basis: The generator evaluates c.m and c' Sigma c from decimal literals in exact Fractions, and the population mean and variance of the aligned row combinations in exact Fractions, rounding to float once. It imports no Antecedent code and calls no propagation routine. The covariance matrix is built as a Gram matrix plus a ridge so it is positive definite by construction; the self-test shows that dropping the cross terms changes the variance. The executing assertion drives the public propagation entry points with the fixture inputs and compares the claim values; the refusal list is the stated rule that dependence between pieces of one transported claim is never assumed away.
historical_exposure: Authored for this fixture from the closed-form delta-method and linear-moment definitions; no product implementation source or product output was consulted to derive the values, and no earlier harness exists.
redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and hand-constructed inputs; Python standard library only, no upstream code or data is stored.
limitations: One three-piece covariance and one eight-row aligned set; point moments only, with no interval or coverage claim. The refusal list is a stated rule, not a derived quantity.
